name: Fred Meyer Distribution Center Chehalis WA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Main truck entrance is a wide open curb-cut driveway off Maurin Rd at 46.6266,-122.9135, split by a small landscaped median island. Street View (2026-03) shows NO barrier arm, NO gate panel across the truck lane, and NO checkpoint structure. Perimeter is chain-link fenced but the truck lane itself is open.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth at the entrance. Only a light pole and a landscaped median island on the drive; no booth-sized structure beside the lane in either satellite z20 or Street View.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks on two distinct building faces - long door bank on the north face (FedEx/retail trailers backed in) and a second long bank on the south face - consistent with separate ship/receive clusters.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Both north and south faces carry continuous door banks across a ~700m building; 140 is an honest overhead estimate, easily 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer storage: a large reefer/dry trailer yard NORTH across Maurin Rd plus long drop lanes wrapping the south and west of the building.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Entrance drive opens into a very deep paved yard; 3+ trucks can queue before reaching dock doors.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge of Chehalis, surrounded by farmland and open fields; rural setting.
